content_sections.heading: About Siddipet Model Schools
content_sections.text: The posts are in the Telangana Model Schools of Siddipet District, Telangana. The recruitment is run by the District Outsourcing Committee, Siddipet, and the notification is signed by the District Employment Officer, IDOC - Siddipet, the District Education Officer, IDOC - Siddipet, and for the District Collector, Siddipet. The pay is a gross remuneration paid through an outsourcing agency.

content_sections.heading: Siddipet Model Schools Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: As of 12 November 2026, the application window is open; it closes on 17 November 2026 at 05.00 P.M.

rows.event: Last date of receipt of Applications
Publication of provisional Merit list (after certificate verification)

content_sections.heading: Siddipet Model Schools Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification lists 56 vacancies in Telangana Model Schools, Siddipet, 14 for each post. The notification does not print a category-wise break-up. It states that the rule of reservation will be followed as per Government norms and that the roster point will be followed for each category of post.

content_sections.heading: Siddipet Model Schools Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: 5 years' experience in State Government or Central Government institutions or programmes on contract or outsourcing basis, or in private institutions, will be given priority. For the Art Teacher post, MFA/BFA candidates will be given priority. If candidates with a graduation certificate are not available for any post, persons with a Diploma certificate will be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification_required: MFA/BFA in applied Art, Painting, Sculpture, commercial Arts, Print making and Animation
Graduation and Diploma in Yoga / Degree in Yoga / B.P.Ed with Yoga Specialization
Masters / Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, IT, B.Tech / B.E / MCA / BCA / BSC (computers) / B.Com (Computers)
Masters or Bachelors Degree in Library Science / Library and Information Science (B.Lib.Sc/BLIS) from a recognized university

content_sections.heading: Siddipet Model Schools Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: For all four posts, the minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 44 years, reckoned as on 01.09.2026, as per A.P. State and Subordinate Services Rule 12 (1) (v) adopted by Telangana State and G.O. Ms. No. 30 GAD (Ser) Dept., Dt. 08/02/2024. The notification also states that candidates born between 01.09.1980 and 31.08.2008 are only eligible to apply. The notification adds a note that the Government of Telangana issued an adhoc rule raising the upper age limit by 10 years and an additional 2 years, i.e. from 34 to 46, for a period of 2 years from the date of issue of the Government Order, in addition to G.O. Ms.No. 42, GAD (Ser.A) Dept., Dt.19/03/2022.

content_sections.heading: Siddipet Model Schools Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is made on merit marks, with total marks counted out of 50, followed by original certificate verification and the merit lists. Merit marks calculated from academic records and experience (see the table below). Publication of registered candidates list and scrutiny of applications. Publication of provisional list. Original certificate verification on 04/12/2026 and 05/12/2026 at DEO office, IDOC, Siddipet. Provisional merit list after certificate verification, then the final merit list. For B.Tech / B.E / MCA / BCA students, there is no specialization merit for the Computer Teacher post. Only experience in the same position counts; for example, for the Librarian post only Librarian experience will be considered. For the Art Teacher post, MFA/BFA candidates will be given priority. Roster point will be followed for each category of post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Siddipet Model Schools Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the QR code for the application, available at all Model Schools in Siddipet District, the District Education Office, IDOC, and on the District Collector Office website Siddipet (siddipet.telangana.gov.in). Fill the application through the QR code; the notice says forms shall be filled through the QR code only. The offline application form is also available on the District website Siddipet. Upload all original certificates through the QR code, as the notice instructs. Take the response of the Google form and the filled application, with Xerox copies of the documents listed below. Submit them at the District Education Office, IDOC - Siddipet (item 9 of the notice also says filled applications should be submitted at the nearest Model Schools). Make sure the application is received by 17 November 2026, 05.00 P.M. Carry all original certificates on the day of certificate verification (04 and 05 December 2026). Filled in application form (response of the Google form) Aadhar Card Proof of Date of Birth (SSC / Birth certificate) Study / Bonafide certificates, 1st to 7th class SSC memo Intermediate (or) Diploma certificate Degree / Graduation memo Specialization certificate with marks memo: Yoga Teacher – Degree or Diploma in Yoga; Art Teacher – MFA/BFA in Art / Sculpture / Commercial Arts / Print making and Animation; Computer Teacher – Masters / Bachelors in Computer Science, B.Tech / B.E / BCA / MCA / B.com (comp) or B.S.C (comp); Librarian – Masters or degree in Library Science Community Certificate Copy of experience certificate (State or Central Government institutions or programmes on contract / outsourcing basis, or private institutions)

content_sections.heading: Siddipet Model Schools Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary, up to 23.04.2027, or till the vacancies are filled by promotion or regular appointment, or till the actual need ceases, whichever is earlier. The outsourcing placement does not confer any right for future Government appointment. The engaged employee will be under the administrative control of the District Education Officer on whole time basis. The selected candidate will be eligible for 15 days of leave in a calendar year on cumulative basis as per existing norms. If a selected candidate does not join within the stipulated time, the next eligible merit candidate will be selected. Filled applications with Xerox copies of documents are also to be submitted on the day of certificate verification, and candidates should carry all original certificates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Siddipet Model Schools Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 56 vacancies: 14 each for Art Teacher, Yoga Teacher, Computer Teacher and Librarian in Telangana Model Schools, Siddipet.

faq.question: Q2. When did the Siddipet Model Schools application start?
faq.answer: Submission of applications started on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Siddipet Model Schools Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 17 November 2026, 05.00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Siddipet Model Schools posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01.09.2026, with 5 years' relaxation for SCs and STs, 3 years plus Armed forces service for ex-servicemen, and 10 years for disabled persons.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for the Computer Teacher post?
faq.answer: Masters / Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, IT, B.Tech / B.E / MCA / BCA / BSC (computers) / B.Com (Computers).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Siddipet Model Schools posts?
faq.answer: Art, Yoga and Computer Teachers get Rs. 22,750 per month and the Librarian gets Rs. 19,500 per month, gross and all inclusive, through the outsourcing agency.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on merit marks out of 50, with 10% each from SSC, Inter or Diploma, Degree, specialization and Government experience (5% for private experience), followed by original certificate verification on 04 and 05 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Siddipet Model Schools job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary on outsourcing basis up to 23.04.2027, or till the vacancies are filled regularly or the need ceases, whichever is earlier, and gives no right to future Government appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the application submitted?
faq.answer: The notice says filled applications with Xerox copies of documents are to be submitted at the District Education Office, IDOC - Siddipet; item 9 of the notice also mentions the nearest Model Schools.

faq.question: Q10. When will the final merit list be published?
faq.answer: The final merit list is scheduled for 08 December 2026, after the provisional merit list on 07 December 2026.
